content:
The [[River of Crystal Waters]] passes through this hex. [[Castle Tarengael]] is built on a rocky island in the middle of the river. Bridges connect the castle to the settlements of Eastbridge and Westbridge, which are together referred to as [[Tarengael Town]]. Around are fields for crops, and behind a ridge is the [[Swamp of Champions]], a key part of trial by combat in this area.

===Features===
*The Swamp of Champions: ritual dueling is better with trebuchets. This is the final destination of the loser of a [[Battle of the Hand]]

===Connections:===
*An old watchtower was once built to protect the borders of '''Thring''' (20.18) but it is now inhabited by the Foolish Sages who were exiled by the Duke.

===Hooks:===
*What is the river that feeds into the [[Brindlebrook Swamp]] from the northern [[Grey Moutains]]? The [[Brindlebrook]]?
